notes.title: Closed Beta
notes.content:
We will start the Closed Beta of Project Horror Anthology: Project Prequel that will last for two weeks, and with it some news, check it out below:
[list]
[*] Support for Control.
[*] New alternate ending.
[*] New chests added.
[*] New animations.
[*] GIF updates.
[*] Trailer Update.
[*] Bug Fixes.
[/list]
To get access to the Closed Beta, consider supporting us by clicking  [url=https://www.catarse.me/ProjectHorrorAnthology?project_id=162685&project_user_id]here[/url].

Remembering, [b]bugs[/b] may occur during the [b]beta[/b], feel free to report them to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/bEETzARnzG]Discord[/url] if you encounter any.

Studio Vyrsar Games[/b] thanks you for your attention!
